title: abrodictyum angustimarginatum
intro: Abrodictyum angustimarginatum, commonly known as the narrow-margined polypodium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern native to Southeast Asia, known for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Abrodictyum angustimarginatum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
